title: SnapshotManifest
description: Published snapshot manifest for create-agent-harness knowledge library (schema_version 1, format_version 1).

schema_version.description: Schema version of the manifest format

format_version.description: Format version of the exported SQLite catalog file

catalog_id.description: Namespace identifier for the shared catalog

generation.description: Unique immutable generation identifier for this snapshot

parent_generation.description: Previous generation identifier, if this was built incrementally

input_commit.description: Git commit SHA of the source registry repository used to produce this snapshot

source_summary.description: Summary counts of sources included, active, and failed

document_count.description: Total number of document revisions stored in the snapshot

chunk_count.description: Total number of text chunks indexed in the snapshot

model_fingerprint.description: Deterministic SHA-256 fingerprint of the embedding model profile

sqlite_vec_version.description: Exact version of sqlite-vec used to generate the vector index, if applicable

file_size_bytes.description: Byte size of the exported catalog.sqlite file

file_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex checksum of the exported catalog.sqlite file

min_reader_version.description: Minimum client harness version required to read and query this snapshot
